name: Similarity groups activate at three gated spots
non_visual_rationale: Which parent carried a spot is visible only as a stored number's neighbourhood. No template, string, style or route is touched, and the published surface is byte-identical: at launch no spot has passed the gates, so no family can form. U1-U8 and a Vera walk are N/A.
criteria_delivered: 1. With three gated beach spots, a new beach spot's parent is the beach family's estimate rather than the region-wide mean. Proven by running the same seven spots twice and changing exactly one thing about the third beach spot: who reported its mornings.

2. With only two gated beach spots the group stays collapsed and the region-wide parent carries the newcomer, pinned to the exact arithmetic (2/(2+tau) of its own claim plus 6/(2+tau) of the region-wide estimate) rather than compared loosely.

3. Activation is data-driven per group: no code change and no configuration flip is involved. The two runs execute identical code with identical configuration; the only difference is that six people reported the third beach spot's twelve mornings instead of four.
scope_note: The accepted roadmap names only hierarchy.ts and the unit laws. constants.ts and correction-file.ts were also touched, and had to be: the threshold needs a declared home (SIMILARITY_GROUP_MIN_GATED_SPOTS = 3, 06 section 5.3 and adr-pooling-hierarchy-activation decision 3), and the two-pass ordering the circularity below forces lives at the call site rather than inside the ladder.
design_decisions_not_stated_upstream: THE ACTIVATION CIRCLE, CUT ONCE AND NOT ITERATED. A family activates on how many of its spots have passed the correction gates; whether a spot passes depends on the value it was shrunk to, which depends on the parent, which is what the family would change. 06 section 5.3 does not say which pass decides. Decision: the collapsed pass decides. buildCorrectionRecords runs the ladder twice -- once with nothing proven, so the gate weighs each spot's own evidence against its region alone, then once knowing which spots earned a correction -- and only the second pass's numbers are ever stored. Not iterated to a fixed point: the gate's job is to certify a spot's OWN evidence, which the collapsed pass is exactly where to measure, and a loop over a threshold can oscillate.

THE FAMILY IS KEYED ON (region, break_type), NOT ON break_type ALONE. 06 section 5.3 places the similarity level between region and spot, so a family lives inside one region: 'the beaches of pa-pacific', never 'the beaches of the world'. Falls out of the ladder's nesting rather than being enforced separately.

A FAMILY BELOW THE THRESHOLD COSTS ITS MEMBERS NOTHING. familyParent returns the region's estimate untouched rather than shrinking toward it with a weight, so an unformed family adds not even a rounding step. This is what keeps the launch shape exact.

hierarchy.ts NEVER JUDGES EVIDENCE. It counts a decided boolean carried on SpotEvidence.gated. Only src/learning/gates.ts may weigh evidence or construct the applied state, and src/learning/declarations.ts's whole-source examination enforces that across the tree; the ladder stays a stranger to it. tests/unit/learning-declarations.test.ts was run against the new module and passes.
acceptance: One example, two runs of the real runLearningFitOnce port over SEVEN spots, differing in exactly one thing that is deliberately not the data any estimate is built from: the third beach spot's twelve mornings are reported by six people in one run and four in the other. Same mornings, same residuals, same counts, same weighted means, therefore the same region-wide estimate in both runs -- only the count of GATED beach spots moves, from three to two. Three guards make that airtight rather than asserted: the third beach spot is asserted applied in one run and not the other, asserted to carry the same morning count in both, and a reef spot's stored difference is asserted BYTE-IDENTICAL across the runs. The reefs are three-gated in both runs, so if anything other than beach-family activation had shifted underneath, the reef control would have moved with it.
unit_law: One new fast-check property in tests/unit/learning-hierarchy-laws.test.ts, quantified over the number of proven spots from zero to four and over arbitrary beach and reef estimates: below SIMILARITY_GROUP_MIN_GATED_SPOTS the region-wide estimate carries the newcomer to within 1e-12, and at or above it the family's own shrunken estimate does, and the newcomer sits nearer what the family reads than the region-wide mean does. The threshold is read from the constant, so a future change to the number moves the law with it rather than leaving a stale 3 in a test.
test_budget: Behaviours: (1) three proven spots of a break type start pooling among themselves, (2) two do not. Two behaviours, budget 4. Delivered 2: one acceptance example carrying both halves (the fired and the unfired case are the same comparison seen from its two ends, and splitting them would duplicate a seven-spot fixture) and one unit property covering every count from zero to four.
red_evidence: The acceptance example was written first and run against the 03-02 body: RED with AssertionError on 'one more proven beach spot must change what carries the newcomer, with no code change and no configuration flip' -- the newcomer's stored difference was identical in both runs, because the similarity level did not exist. The unit property was written next and passed only after familyParent landed.
falsifiability_evidence: Three controlled mutations, each planted alone, each reverted, each verified byte-for-byte against a snapshot. (P1) the threshold check removed, so every family pools regardless of evidence: three tests fail, the property on 'with only 0 proven beach spots the region-wide estimate must carry the newcomer', the acceptance example, and the region-cap law -- the last correctly, because with no threshold a lone spot forms a family of one and shrinks an extra time. (P2) the threshold made 2 instead of 3, the off-by-one this step exists to get right: the property fails at exactly 2 proven spots and the acceptance example fails on its notEqual guard, because both runs then have a family. (P3) the second pass fed NOTHING_PROVEN_YET, i.e. the two-pass wiring severed while the ladder itself stays correct: the acceptance example fails alone. PROCESS NOTE, recorded because it nearly produced a false clean sheet: the first attempt at this mutation set reported exit 0 for all three. The cause was shell word-splitting -- the two test paths were passed through a variable, vitest matched no files, and 'no test files found' exits 0. The runs above pass the paths literally. A mutation harness that can report success by running nothing is worse than no harness, and the check that caught it was reading the output file rather than the exit code.
gates_run: npm run typecheck exit 0. Full suite at --maxWorkers=4 exit 0, 468 passed across 89 files, up from 466 across 88, which is exactly this step's 2 new tests. npm run build exit 0.
